tools.name: validate
tools.description:
Validate structured data against a Blueprint's rules BEFORE the result
    is used. Returns PASS, FAIL, or REVIEW with plain-language findings,
    repair suggestions, a determinism hash, and a re-verifiable
    certificate. Same input + same rules = same verdict, every time.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

source_text.description: Optional. The text of the document the fields were extracted from. When the Blueprint has a source check, extracted values are compared against this text. It is used for the check only and is not stored
source_text.title: Source Text

tools.name: validate_repair
tools.description:
Validate structured data against a Blueprint and, when it fails,
    include repair suggestions (corrected values with the rule each fix is
    based on) in the same call. Same verdicts as validate: PASS, FAIL, or
    REVIEW, with reasons and proof.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: create_blueprint
tools.description:
Create a Blueprint - the governance contract validation runs against.

    A Blueprint defines what correct means for your data: fields, the math
    that must hold between them, and acceptable ranges. Start from
    load_rule_pack or discover_patterns if you have no rules yet; invoke
    the blueprint_guide prompt for the full rule/constraint reference.
    Returns the new Blueprint's API key.

customer_name.description: Organization or project name (also used for storage folder naming)
customer_name.title: Customer Name

workflow_name.description: Unique Blueprint identifier; the value passed as 'blueprint' in validate
workflow_name.title: Workflow Name

mode.description: observe: platform checks the agent's work; enforce: platform computes derived fields itself
mode.title: Mode

extracted_fields.description: Field names the agent extracts from source data, e.g. ['vendor','qty','unit_cost']
extracted_fields.title: Extracted Fields

derived_fields.description: Field names the platform computes from other fields, e.g. ['subtotal','total']
derived_fields.title: Derived Fields

derivation_rules.description: Math rules as objects. Types: add, subtract, multiply, divide, round, copy, sum (multi-operand), items_multiply, items_sum. Each needs 'type' plus its fields; see the blueprint_guide prompt
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

formal_constraints.description: Constraint objects. Types incl. magnitude_anchor {field,min,max}, relative_anchor {field,reference_field,ratio_min,ratio_max}, max_action_threshold {field,threshold,on_violation}, required_fields {fields}, equals, range, in_set, regex_match, items_magnitude_anchor; see the blueprint_guide prompt
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

require_provenance.description: Require extraction source locations for fields
require_provenance.title: Require Provenance

require_high_assurance.description: Strictest mode: every check must pass
require_high_assurance.title: Require High Assurance

enable_anomaly_detection.description: Flag records that break no rules but do not fit the reference pattern
enable_anomaly_detection.title: Enable Anomaly Detection

tools.name: list_blueprints
tools.description:
List the Blueprints on this account with field/rule/constraint counts
    and mode. Use the returned workflow_name as 'blueprint' in validate.

tools.name: repair
tools.description:
One-shot repair: return corrected values that would make failing data
    valid under the Blueprint. Use repair_path to see the steps instead.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

derivation_rules.description: Math rules as objects. Types: add, subtract, multiply, divide, round, copy, sum (multi-operand), items_multiply, items_sum. Each needs 'type' plus its fields; see the blueprint_guide prompt
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

formal_constraints.description: Constraint objects. Types incl. magnitude_anchor {field,min,max}, relative_anchor {field,reference_field,ratio_min,ratio_max}, max_action_threshold {field,threshold,on_violation}, required_fields {fields}, equals, range, in_set, regex_match, items_magnitude_anchor; see the blueprint_guide prompt
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

tools.name: check_blueprint_health
tools.description:
Static pre-deploy analysis of a Blueprint's rule set. Returns a health
    verdict - healthy, acceptable, fragile, rigid, split, brittle_islands,
    or unsatisfiable - with advice, including joint conflicts pairwise
    checks miss.

config.description: Raw blueprint config with derivation_rules and formal_constraints (used when 'blueprint' is not given)
config.title: Config

tools.name: compare_semantic_equivalence
tools.description:
Compare two payloads under the dual-hash design: content_hash is
    content_hash normalizes field order and numeric formatting. Semantic
    comparison preserves field roles; renaming requires an explicit bijection.
    With supplied rules, scalar types and whitespace remain significant.
    Structural similarity alone does not establish decision equivalence.

payload_b.description: Second structured payload to compare against payload_a
payload_b.title: Payload B

field_mapping.description: Explicit one-to-one field renaming from A to B
field_mapping.title: Field Mapping

tools.name: govern_inference
tools.description:
Quality-govern an in-progress AI generation step BEFORE its output is
    used (complements validate, which checks finished documents). Returns
    an action - STOP, CONTINUE, REPAIR_REGION, REUSE_MOTIF, REVIEW,
    ESCALATE - with a plain-language explanation. Structural scores do not
    establish task correctness. Check safe_to_finalize and acceptance coverage.
    Persistence success is reported; read traces in the same Blueprint namespace.

task_type.description: Kind of generation step being governed
task_type.title: Task Type

inference_id.description: Caller-chosen ID grouping the steps of one generation
inference_id.title: Inference Id

source.description: Free-form caller label recorded for audit
source.title: Source

blueprint.description: Owned Blueprint namespace for the trace
blueprint.title: Blueprint

tools.name: get_inference_trace
tools.description:
Retrieve the durable audit trail for a governed generation: every
    recorded decision and its reasons.

inference_id.description: Caller-chosen ID grouping the steps of one generation
inference_id.title: Inference Id

blueprint.description: Blueprint namespace used when recording the trace
blueprint.title: Blueprint

blueprint_version.description: Optional historical blueprint_version hash returned by govern_inference
blueprint_version.title: Blueprint Version

tools.name: recent_inference_decisions
tools.description: Recent generation-governance decisions in this owner's Blueprint version.

blueprint.description: Blueprint namespace used when recording the trace
blueprint.title: Blueprint

blueprint_version.description: Optional historical blueprint_version hash returned by govern_inference
blueprint_version.title: Blueprint Version

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description:
Independently re-verify a validation certificate. Integrity mode checks
    the hash chain; full mode (certificate + original data) recomputes
    every attested rule from scratch - trust nothing, recheck everything.

certificate.description: The certificate object from a prior validation response
certificate.title: Certificate

data.description: Original payload for full re-verification; omit for integrity-only mode
data.title: Data

derivation_rules.description: Rule list for independent attestation recomputation (optional)
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

formal_constraints.description: Optional constraints to match against the committed bundle
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

tools.name: profile_blueprint_robustness
tools.description:
Sweep the Blueprint's numeric constraint bounds and report verdict
    stability: the stable band, the scales where the verdict first flips,
    and advice. Use before deploying bound changes.

config.description: Raw blueprint config to profile (used when 'blueprint' is not given)
config.title: Config

tools.name: forecast
tools.description:
Deterministic forward reasoning: from the current data state, generate
    and rank the valid next states reachable under the Blueprint's rules.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: discover_patterns
tools.description:
Learn candidate validation rules and structural document types from a
    batch of your records, deterministically - no Blueprint required.
    Promote results with approve_rule. Source data is not stored.

documents.description: List of structured records (objects) to analyze
documents.title: Documents

tools.name: repair_path
tools.description:
Find the shortest sequence of field changes taking invalid data to a
    valid state, as an ordered path of intermediate states. Different from
    repair (one-shot nearest fix): use repair_path to explain or audit the
    fix, or compare alternative repairs.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: counterfactual
tools.description:
Run the same data under two rule sets and compare which future states
    remain valid - what-if analysis for rule changes.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: analyze_anomaly
tools.description:
Explain whether a record fits the usual pattern for records like it,
    and which fields stand out. No Blueprint required.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: create_chain
tools.description:
Create a multi-agent sequential chain: stages validate in order against
    one Blueprint, repairs propagate forward, TTL bounds the run. Siblings:
    submit_chain_stage advances the chain; handoff_audit verifies a
    transition between stages. Returns chain_id.

blueprint.description: Blueprint governing all stages of the chain
blueprint.title: Blueprint

ttl.description: Chain timeout in seconds; stages cannot advance after expiry
ttl.title: Ttl

tools.name: submit_chain_stage
tools.description:
Submit data for the chain's current stage; the platform validates it
    and advances the chain if it passes. Response includes next-stage info
    and accumulated repairs.

stage.description: Stage name to submit for (must be the chain's current stage)
stage.title: Stage

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: handoff_audit
tools.description:
Audit a handoff between two chain stages: a context capsule of verified
    facts from the prior stage, and (if proposed_data is given) a
    compatibility verdict that catches fields mutated in transit. Siblings:
    create_chain, submit_chain_stage.

proposed_data.description: Data agent B intends to submit; checked for mutation against agent A's verified fields
proposed_data.title: Proposed Data

tools.name: approve_rule
tools.description:
Promote a rule discovered by discover_patterns into Blueprint-ready
    form.

tools.name: reject_rule
tools.description:
Reject a discovered candidate rule so it will not be promoted into a
    Blueprint. Pair with approve_rule after discover_patterns.

tools.name: structural_types
tools.description:
Retrieve the document categories a discover_patterns session identified
    (counts, distinguishing fields, domain hints). Read-only; returns
    status=no_session if discovery has not run for this namespace.

tools.name: decompose_failure
tools.description:
Measure the numeric difference between original and corrected values:
    how much lies along the supplied linear rule directions (projection) and
    how much lies outside them (residual), with per-field contributions.
    Diagnostic only: it does not establish a cause, and neither record is
    verified. Use with a known-correct version to diff against; use
    analyze_anomaly when you only have the suspicious payload.
    Diagnostics-tier tool.

original_values.description: Original numeric field values as {field: number}
original_values.title: Original Values

corrected_values.description: Corrected/expected numeric field values as {field: number}
corrected_values.title: Corrected Values

derivation_rules.description: Math rules as objects. Types: add, subtract, multiply, divide, round, copy, sum (multi-operand), items_multiply, items_sum. Each needs 'type' plus its fields; see the blueprint_guide prompt
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

formal_constraints.description: Constraint objects. Types incl. magnitude_anchor {field,min,max}, relative_anchor {field,reference_field,ratio_min,ratio_max}, max_action_threshold {field,threshold,on_violation}, required_fields {fields}, equals, range, in_set, regex_match, items_magnitude_anchor; see the blueprint_guide prompt
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

blueprint.description: Load rules from this Blueprint instead of passing them inline
blueprint.title: Blueprint

tools.name: geometric_confidence
tools.description:
Summarize an already-computed state_vector into a confidence level
    (high/medium/low) with a recommendation. Post-hoc digest - use
    analyze_anomaly or check_drift for fresh analysis of raw data.

state_vector.description: state_vector object from a prior validate or get_execution_trace result
state_vector.title: State Vector

tools.name: check_realization
tools.description:
Structural realization analysis of a payload against the Blueprint's
    reference configuration (requires a 'realization' block; otherwise
    status=skipped). Diagnostics-tier tool; prefer validate or
    analyze_anomaly for standard checks.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: check_drift
tools.description:
Check whether recent submissions still match the established pattern
    for this Blueprint. Returns a stability verdict and observation count.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: authorize_execution
tools.description:
Go/no-go for a real-world action (payment, filing, API write): runs
    full validation, then the Blueprint's execution gate. authorized=true
    only on PASS; REVIEW means do not proceed automatically. Different
    from validate: validate asks is this data correct, authorize_execution
    asks should this action happen.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: load_rule_pack
tools.description:
Load a prebuilt Blueprint template (invoices, timecards, legal, POs,
    claims). Call without pack_id to list packs; then create_blueprint to
    save a customized copy.

pack_id.description: Rule pack ID; omit to list available packs
pack_id.title: Pack Id

tools.name: get_execution_trace
tools.description:
Run validation and return the per-node execution trace (node names,
    deterministic flags, timing) plus the verdict and determinism hash.
    Use validate for normal operation; this is for debugging and audit
    preparation.

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

tools.name: verify_replay
tools.description:
Check replay commitment integrity and compare recorded execution components.
    Version 4 includes reference context and the final result/status. A match
    compares commitments; this tool does not rerun the workflow or reconstruct
    historical reference populations, and does not prove factual correctness.

contract_b.description: replay_contract object to compare against contract_a
contract_b.title: Contract B

tools.name: account_status
tools.description:
This account's plan, key usage, Blueprint counts, and the deployed
    platform build fingerprint (version, build, deployed).

tools.name: delete_blueprint
tools.description:
Permanently delete a Blueprint and revoke its API keys. Irreversible;
    requires confirm=true. Account-level keys are unaffected.

workflow_name.description: Blueprint to delete; its API keys are revoked
workflow_name.title: Workflow Name

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this irreversible action
confirm.title: Confirm

tools.name: update_blueprint
tools.description:
Update an existing Blueprint in place. Only passed fields change;
    pass [] to clear a list. workflow_name cannot be renamed and existing
    API keys keep working. Different from create_blueprint: modifies an
    existing Blueprint, mints no new key.

workflow_name.description: Unique Blueprint identifier; the value passed as 'blueprint' in validate
workflow_name.title: Workflow Name

customer_name.title: Customer Name

mode.description: New mode: observe or enforce; omit to keep current
mode.title: Mode

extracted_fields.title: Extracted Fields

derived_fields.description: Field names the platform computes from other fields, e.g. ['subtotal','total']
derived_fields.title: Derived Fields

formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

require_provenance.title: Require Provenance

require_high_assurance.description: Strictest mode: every check must pass
require_high_assurance.title: Require High Assurance

enable_anomaly_detection.description: Flag records that break no rules but do not fit the reference pattern
enable_anomaly_detection.title: Enable Anomaly Detection

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List this account's API keys (masked) with their Blueprint bindings.

tools.name: rotate_api_key
tools.description:
Replace an API key with a fresh one. The old key stops working
    immediately; the new key inherits its bindings.

key_to_rotate.description: The gai_ key to rotate; it stops working immediately
key_to_rotate.title: Key To Rotate

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description:
Permanently delete one of the caller's API keys.

    DESTRUCTIVE — agents using the deleted key will receive auth
    errors immediately. The Blueprint a key was tied to (if any) is
    NOT affected; only the credential is revoked. To delete a
    Blueprint and all its keys, use delete_blueprint.

    The target key can be specified two ways:
      - As the full key string (gai_...).
      - As a key_id (SHA-256 hash from list_api_keys).

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this irreversible action
confirm.title: Confirm
